description: This is a test class file for the MenuDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing data access operations related to menu items, modules, and their hierarchy in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: MenuDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing MenuDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM HRM system. Contains setup and multiple test methods for menu item enabling, retrieval, and hierarchy validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture by populating test data and instantiating the MenuDao object.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items for a specific module and verifies the count of affected items.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItemsByTitle
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items identified by module name and specific titles, verifying the count of affected items.

methods.name: testGetMenuLevel
methods.description: Tests retrieving a menu item by module and screen, then validating its properties such as title, parent id, level, order hint, and status.

methods.name: testGetModuleByName
methods.description: Tests fetching module details by name and verifying display names.
